# Setup

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
library(cowplot)
library(lmerTest)
obj_is_vector = function(x){TRUE}

# Load data

participants <- read.csv("../data/conversation_Participant.csv")
question.response <- read.csv("../data/conversation_QuestionResponse.csv")
questions <- read.csv("../data/conversation_Question.csv")
conversation <- read.csv("../data/conversation_Conversation.csv")
messages <- read.csv("../data/conversation_Message.csv")
persuadability <- read.csv("../data/conversation_PersuadabilityResponse.csv")
persuader <- read.csv("../data/conversation_AIPersuader.csv")
persuadability.questions <- read.csv("../data/conversation_PersuadabilityQuestion.csv")

```

## Merge & Filter data

```{r}

participants <- participants %>%
  filter(
    study == "1",
    source == "sona",
    !(sona_code %in% c("131", "test")),
    end_time != "",
    start_time > "2025-03-03",
    start_time < "2025-03-11",
    feedback_condition == 1
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    id = as.factor(id),
    source = as.factor(source),
    study = as.factor(study),
    gender = as.factor(gender),
    native_english = as.factor(native_english),
    consulted = as.factor(consulted),
    questions_balanced = as.factor(questions_balanced),
    intro_condition = case_when(
      intro_condition == 1 ~ "Helpful",
      intro_condition == 0 ~ "Mixed",
      intro_condition == -1 ~ "Unhelpful"
    )
  )

question.response <- question.response %>%
  distinct(participant_id, question_id, response_type, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  merge(participants, how="right", by.x = "participant_id", by.y="id") %>%
  merge(questions, how = "left", by.x = "question_id", by.y= "id") %>%
  mutate(
    response_code = ifelse(response == answer1, "answer1", "answer2"),
    # response = factor(response, levels=c(answer1, answer2)),
    accuracy = ifelse(response_code == correct_answer, 1, 0),
    confidence_directional = ifelse(response == answer2, confidence, -1 * confidence)
  )

attn.checks <- question.response %>%
  filter(category == "attention_check")

question.response <- question.response %>%
  filter(category != "attention_check")

qr.pre <- question.response %>%
  filter(response_type == "pre")

conversation <- conversation %>%
  rename(conversation_index = "trial_index",
         conversation_id = "id") %>%
  filter(end_time != "") %>%
  mutate(
    start_time = as.POSIXct(start_time, format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%OS", tz = "UTC"),
    end_time = as.POSIXct(end_time, format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%OS", tz = "UTC"),
    conversation_duration = as.numeric(end_time - start_time, units = "secs"),
    ai_persuader_id = 2
  ) %>%
  select(-correct_answer, -start_time, -end_time) %>%
  # Merge persuader
  merge(
    persuader %>%
      select(id, model_name),
    by.x = "ai_persuader_id", by.y="id"
  ) %>%
  merge(
    messages %>%
  group_by(conversation_id) %>%
  summarize(n_messages = n()), how = "left", by = "conversation_id"
  )

qr.post <- question.response %>%
  filter(response_type == "post") %>%
  merge(conversation, how="left", all.x=T, by=c("question_id", "participant_id")) %>%
    merge(
  qr.pre %>%
      mutate(
        response_pre = response,
        confidence_pre = confidence,
        confidence_directional_pre = confidence_directional,
        ) %>%
      select(question_id, participant_id, response_pre, confidence_pre, confidence_directional_pre)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    persuader_correct = persuader_answer == correct_answer,
    persuader_success = persuader_answer == response_code,
    mind_changed = target_answer != response_code,
    persuader_changed_mind = case_when(
      mind_changed & persuader_success ~ "converted",
      mind_changed ~ "backfire",
      persuader_success ~ "sustained",
      T ~ "recalcitrant"
    ),
    confidence_to_persuader_answer = ifelse(persuader_answer == "answer2", confidence_directional, -1 * confidence_directional),
    confidence_to_persuader_answer_pre = ifelse(persuader_answer == "answer2", confidence_directional_pre, -1 * confidence_directional_pre),
    confidence_change_to_persuader_answer = (confidence_to_persuader_answer - confidence_to_persuader_answer_pre) / 2
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !(is.na(target_answer))
  )


persuadability <- persuadability %>%
  merge(participants, how="right", by.x = "participant_id", by.y="id")

```

# Exclusions

## Attn checks

```{r}

mean(attn.checks$accuracy)

```

```{r}
attn.checks %>% group_by(participant_id) %>% summarize(accuracy = mean(accuracy)) %>%
  filter(accuracy < 1) 

```

```{r}

ppts.attn.fail <- attn.checks %>% group_by(participant_id) %>% summarize(accuracy = mean(accuracy)) %>%
  filter(accuracy < 1) %>%
  pull(participant_id)

participants <- participants %>% filter(!(id %in% ppts.attn.fail))
conversation <- conversation %>% filter(!(participant_id %in% ppts.attn.fail))
qr.pre <- qr.pre %>% filter(!(participant_id %in% ppts.attn.fail))
qr.post <- qr.post %>% filter(!(participant_id %in% ppts.attn.fail))

```

## Reaction time

```{r}

qr.pre %>%
  group_by(participant_id) %>%
  summarize(rt = mean(reaction_time), accuracy = mean(accuracy)) %>%
  filter(rt < 5000)

```

```{r}

ppts.fast.rt <- qr.pre %>%
  group_by(participant_id) %>%
  summarize(rt = mean(reaction_time), accuracy = mean(accuracy)) %>%
  filter(rt < 5000) %>%
  pull(participant_id)

participants <- participants %>% filter(!(id %in% ppts.fast.rt))
conversation <- conversation %>% filter(!(participant_id %in% ppts.fast.rt))
qr.pre <- qr.pre %>% filter(!(participant_id %in% ppts.fast.rt))
qr.post <- qr.post %>% filter(!(participant_id %in% ppts.fast.rt))
persuadability <- persuadability %>% filter(participant_id %in% participants$id)

```

## Summary of exclusions

```{r}

reasons <- c(
  "attn_check",
  "sources_consulted",
  "fast_rt",
  "total excluded",
  "retained"
)
excluded <- c(
  length(ppts.attn.fail),
  length(ppts.sources.consulted),
  length(ppts.fast.rt),
  length(ppts.attn.fail) + length(ppts.sources.consulted) + length(ppts.fast.rt),
  nrow(participants)
)

exclusions <- data.frame(
  reasons,
  excluded
) %>%
  mutate(
    prop = excluded / nrow(participants) * 100
  )

exclusions

```

# Conversations

```{r}

# The conversation table's end_time is unreliable (stale values), so
# duration is computed from message timestamps instead.
# Averaged over analyzed trials (qr.post).
message.durations <- messages %>%
  filter(conversation_id %in% conversation$conversation_id) %>%
  mutate(timestamp = as.POSIXct(timestamp, format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%OS", tz = "UTC")) %>%
  group_by(conversation_id) %>%
  summarize(duration = as.numeric(max(timestamp) - min(timestamp), units = "secs"))

qr.post %>%
  merge(message.durations, by = "conversation_id") %>%
  summarize(duration_mins = mean(duration) / 60,
            sd_duration = sd(duration / 60),
            n_messages = mean(n_messages))

```

## Chance baseline for Persuader Success

```{r}

qr.post.final <- qr.post.final %>%
  mutate(
    p_chance = (1 - confidence_pre / 100) / 2,
    p_chance = pmin(pmax(p_chance, 0.005), 0.995),
    chance_offset = qlogis(p_chance)
  )

cat(sprintf("Final-trial chance baseline: mean = %.1f%% (mean confidence_pre = %.1f%%)\n",
            mean(qr.post.final$p_chance) * 100, mean(qr.post.final$confidence_pre)))

ps_vs_chance <- function(d) {
  glmer(persuader_success ~ 1 + (1 | question_id) + offset(chance_offset),
        family = "binomial", data = d)
}

```

### H1: Historically helpful models are persuasive

#### H1a: Confidence Change

```{r}

m.h1a <- lmer(confidence_change_to_persuader_answer ~ 1 + (1 | question_id),
            data = qr.post.final %>%
              filter(intro_condition %in% c("Helpful")))
summary(m.h1a)

```

#### H1b: Persuader Success (vs. chance)

```{r}

m.h1b <- ps_vs_chance(qr.post.final %>% filter(intro_condition == "Helpful"))
summary(m.h1b)

```

### H2: Historically mixed models are persuasive

#### H2a: Confidence Change

```{r}

m.h2a <- lmer(confidence_change_to_persuader_answer ~ 1 + (1 | question_id),

```

#### H2b: Persuader Success (vs. chance)

```{r}

summary(m.h2b)

```

#### H7a: Helpful vs Mixed (CC)

```{r}
            data = qr.post.final %>%
              filter(intro_condition %in% c("Helpful", "Mixed")))

```

#### H7b: Helpful vs Mixed (PS)

```{r}

            family = "binomial",
```


#### H7d: Helpful vs Unhelpful (PS)

```{r}

summary(m.h7d)

```

## Sensitivity: unidentified question variance in chance tests

```{r}

glm_vs_chance <- function(d) {
  glm(persuader_success ~ 1 + offset(chance_offset), family = "binomial", data = d)
}
lrt_vs_chance <- function(d) {
  m1 <- ps_vs_chance(d)
  m0 <- glmer(persuader_success ~ 0 + (1 | question_id) + offset(chance_offset),
              family = "binomial", data = d)
  anova(m0, m1)
}

d.h1b <- qr.post.final %>% filter(intro_condition == "Helpful")
d.h3b <- qr.post.final %>% filter(intro_condition %in% c("Helpful"), persuader_correct == F)

as.data.frame(VarCorr(m.h1b))
as.data.frame(VarCorr(m.h3b))

m.h1b.glm <- glm_vs_chance(d.h1b)
summary(m.h1b.glm)
lrt.h1b <- lrt_vs_chance(d.h1b)
lrt.h1b

m.h3b.glm <- glm_vs_chance(d.h3b)
summary(m.h3b.glm)
lrt.h3b <- lrt_vs_chance(d.h3b)
lrt.h3b

kr.unhelpful.cc <- coef(summary(m.unhelpful.cc, ddf = "Kenward-Roger"))
kr.unhelpful.cc

```

# Stats file

```{r}

stat_row <- function(model, hypothesis, measure, term = NULL) {
  cs <- coef(summary(model))
  if (is.null(term)) term <- rownames(cs)[nrow(cs)]
  z.model <- "z value" %in% colnames(cs)
  data.frame(
    experiment = "E1",
    hypothesis = hypothesis,
    measure = measure,
    term = term,
    b = cs[term, "Estimate"],
    se = cs[term, "Std. Error"],
    stat_type = ifelse(z.model, "z", "t"),
    stat = cs[term, ifelse(z.model, "z value", "t value")],
    df = ifelse(z.model, NA, ifelse("df" %in% colnames(cs), cs[term, "df"], df.residual(model))),
    p = cs[term, ifelse(z.model, "Pr(>|z|)", "Pr(>|t|)")],
    n = nobs(model)
  )
}

cor_row <- function(ct, hypothesis, measure) {
  data.frame(
    experiment = "E1",
    hypothesis = hypothesis,
    measure = measure,
    term = "stp",
    b = unname(ct$estimate),
    se = NA,
    stat_type = "r",
    stat = unname(ct$estimate),
    df = unname(ct$parameter),
    p = ct$p.value,
    n = unname(ct$parameter) + 2
  )
}

  stat_row(m.h1b.glm, "H1b_noqre", "PS"),
  stat_row(m.h3b.glm, "H3b_noqre", "PS"),
  data.frame(experiment = "E1", hypothesis = "H1b_lrt", measure = "PS", term = "(Intercept)",
             b = NA, se = NA, stat_type = "chisq", stat = lrt.h1b$Chisq[2],
             df = lrt.h1b$Df[2], p = lrt.h1b$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2], n = nrow(d.h1b)),

  stat_row(m.truth.intro, "truth_intro_mixed", "PS"),
  stat_row(m.reliability, "reliability_unhelpful_vs_helpful", "rating", term = "intro_conditionHelpful"),

)
```

## Additional exploratory analyses

### Self-reported expertise (physics / logic / probability)

```{r}

add_expertise <- function(d) {
  d %>%
    mutate(expertise = case_when(
      subcategory == "physics" ~ physics,
      subcategory == "logic" ~ logic,
      subcategory == "probability" ~ probability
    )) %>%
    filter(!is.na(expertise))
}
```
